howto.title: How to play?
howto.subtitle: Quick guide to playing and creating quests
howto.play1Text: Choose a quest and tap “Create game” - a game code appears
howto.play2Text: Participants enter the code on their phones and join the game
howto.play3Text: Click tiles on the board - everyone sees the question
howto.play4Text: Players tap the button on their phone. The first one answers, the rest wait
howto.play5Text: Mark “Correct” or “Wrong” - the score updates automatically
howto.create1Text: On the selection page, tap “New quest”
howto.create2Text: Enter a name and pick the grid size: categories × questions
howto.create3Text: Click tiles and add the question, answer and, if you like, a photo or audio
howto.create4Text: Everything saves automatically - come back and start the game

seo.howtoLead: Step-by-step guide: the host runs the board on a screen, players join from their phones.
seo.howtoBullet1: Category board on the big screen
seo.howtoBullet2: Join with a four-digit game code
seo.howtoBullet3: Tap Answer - whoever buzzes first responds
seo.howtoPlayIntro: From Create game to updating the score:
seo.howtoCreateIntro: Build your own quest in minutes - everything saves automatically:
seo.howtoHostText: Show the board on a large screen. Read questions aloud. After a buzz, allow 5–10 seconds, then mark Correct or Wrong.
seo.howtoPlayerText: Join from your phone on Wi‑Fi or mobile data. Keep the tab open - Answer appears only after the host opens a question.
seo.howtoFaq1Q: How many people can play at once?
seo.howtoFaq1A: Up to 20 participants per session - each on their own phone. For larger groups, split into teams and take turns.
seo.howtoFaq2Q: Do I need to install an app?
seo.howtoFaq2A: No. Quiz Quest runs in the browser: the host on a computer, players on phones. No sign-up required.
seo.howtoFaq3A: With a ready pack (Movie Night or Hit Parade) - about a minute: pick a quest, tap Create game, share the code. A custom quest from scratch takes 10–30 minutes depending on question count.
seo.howtoCtaText: Go back home, pick a ready-made pack or build your own - then invite friends with the game code.
seo.movieLead: A ready-made Movie Night pack for friends: iconic films and series without magic or the supernatural - posters, quotes, cast and soundtracks in one Jeopardy-style board.
seo.movieBullet2: IMDb hits: from Shawshank and Titanic to Breaking Bad and Oppenheimer
seo.movieBullet3: Appears automatically in the host lobby - play right away
seo.musicLead: Hit Parade is a ready music pack: chart hits and classics with lyric gaps, artists, albums and collabs - built for a loud living-room party.
seo.musicBullet1: Beatles, Queen, pop, rock, hip-hop and dance in one pack
seo.musicBullet2: 75 questions: from missing words to deeper trivia
seo.musicBullet3: Perfect for a party - friends join from their phones
seo.movieBody: The board is built for a long evening: three rounds, five categories and five difficulty levels - 75 questions total. Topics stay on the popular side of cinema and TV, so most guests can join in without being film-school experts. Questions mix recognition, quotes and soundtrack trivia so the pace stays lively.
seo.movieHowText: On the home page tap Create game, pick Movie Night in the host lobby, share the four-digit code. Friends join from their phones; you open tiles on the big screen. No install, no account for players.
seo.movieCtaText: Open the home page and start a game with Movie Night - or switch to Hit Parade if your group is more into charts and lyrics.
seo.musicBody: Seventy-five questions across three rounds cover Beatles and Queen as well as pop, rock, hip-hop and dance. Easy tiles warm the room up; harder ones reward the playlist nerds. Mix missing words with deeper trivia so every round feels different.
seo.musicHowText: Create a game from the home page, choose Hit Parade, send the code. Guests buzz from phones while you drive the board. Works great next to speakers - keep volume ready for celebration moments.
seo.musicCtaText: Go home, tap Create game and pick Hit Parade - or open Movie Night if tonight is more about films than playlists.
seo.packCaption: Ready packs from the host lobby - pick one and start in about a minute.

about.h1: About Quiz Quest - online game for teams & companies
about.lead: A free online game for companies, teams or friends: game-show quiz on a shared board, everyone plays from their phones. Movie Night, Hit Parade, or your own board in minutes.
about.heroCaption: The big screen shows categories and questions. Each player gets an Answer button on their phone.
about.whatText: Quiz Quest is an online game for companies and friends: one screen shows a Jeopardy-style board, players join by code on smartphones. Whoever buzzes first answers out loud. Great for office parties, team building, and game nights without extra hardware.
about.audiencePartyText: Friend meetups, movie nights, or a relaxed evening at home: the game starts in a minute and everyone joins from their phones.
about.audienceFamilyText: Mixed topics and difficulties so different ages can play together.
about.audienceTeamText: Team building or a break: custom boards with inside jokes or ready-made packs.
about.audienceHostText: Control the pace on the host screen; guests or viewers join on phones.
about.rule1Text: opens tiles on the board and judges answers
about.rule2Text: enter the session on a phone, see their name and a buzz button
about.rule3Text: after a question opens, the first to buzz gets to answer
about.rule4Text: a correct answer adds the tile value; a wrong one moves play on as the host decides
about.rule5Text: play until all questions are revealed or you stop - highest score wins
about.howtoLead: The full guide lives on How to play. Short version - from the home page to the first answer:
about.packsText: The host lobby already includes packs so you don’t build a board from scratch:
about.packsMovie: films and series without the supernatural, 75 questions
about.packsMusic: hits and classics, lyrics and trivia, 75 questions
about.faq1Q: Do I need an account to play?
about.faq1A: Players join with a game code on their phone. The host creates a game from the home page - Create game.
about.faq2A: As many as fit around one screen: each player on their own phone. Bigger groups work well as teams.
about.faq3Q: Can I build my own quiz?
about.faq3A: Yes. Create a quest, set the category × question grid, add text, photos or audio - everything saves automatically.
about.faq4A: Yes. Play Quiz Quest free in the browser - no app install.
about.faq5Q: How is it different from Kahoot?
about.faq5A: It’s closer to a classic point board with buzz-in: host on the big screen, answers from phones with a show feel.
about.ctaText: Go back home and tap Create game - pick Movie Night, Hit Parade or your own quest and share the code with friends.
